# Treq

> Treq is an open-source macOS app for managing parallel AI development: create isolated Git workspaces per branch, run coding agents inside them, then review, commit, and merge changes without leaving the app.

## Getting Started

- [Installation and Quickstart](https://treq.dev/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Download Treq for macOS, open a repository, create a workspace, launch an agent, and commit and push changes.

## Concepts

- [Overview](https://treq.dev/docs/intro.md): Four-layer architecture (Interface, Core runtime, Repository-local storage, Global app storage) and how workspaces, reviews, and terminals compose into the Treq model.
- [Workspaces](https://treq.dev/docs/concepts/workspaces.md): Git worktrees under `.treq/workspaces/` — lifecycle management, stacked workspaces, automatic rebasing, branch naming patterns, and caching behavior.
- [Reviews](https://treq.dev/docs/concepts/reviews.md): Local review model — file-level and line-range inline comments, review states (Draft, Changes Requested, Approved), per-file progress tracking, and commit-by-commit inspection.
- [Terminal Sessions](https://treq.dev/docs/concepts/terminal-sessions.md): PTY-backed terminal sessions scoped per workspace; sessions run independently and persist in the background when switching workspaces.
- [Commit Management](https://treq.dev/docs/concepts/commit-management.md): Partial commit selection at file or hunk level, commit history relative to the workspace target, and safe manipulation boundaries that guard against unintended rewrites.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://treq.dev/docs/reference/cli.md): `treq add`, `treq set`, `treq st`, `treq mv`, and `treq agent` — command syntax and flags for creating, inspecting, and operating on workspaces from the terminal.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://treq.dev/docs/reference/keyboard-shortcuts.md): Global shortcuts (`Cmd+N` new workspace, `Cmd+K` command palette), terminal shortcuts (`Cmd+J` toggle, `Cmd+]` new agent terminal), and file browser shortcuts.
- [Contributing](https://treq.dev/docs/reference/contributing.md): Repository layout by layer (`src/`, `src-tauri/src/core/`, `crates/treq-napi/`), development setup, test strategy, implementation rules, and documentation style guide.

## Tutorials

- [Using Treq with a Git Repo](https://treq.dev/docs/tutorials/using-treq-with-git-repo.md): Open an existing repository and create your first workspace.
- [Managing Workspaces](https://treq.dev/docs/tutorials/managing-workspaces.md): Create, rename, stack, and delete workspaces from the dashboard.
- [Committing Changes](https://treq.dev/docs/tutorials/committing-changes.md): Select files and hunks in the diff viewer and write commit messages.
- [Code Review Workflow](https://treq.dev/docs/tutorials/code-review-workflow.md): Navigate the review interface, leave inline comments, send feedback to the agent terminal, and approve or request changes.
- [Merging Workspaces](https://treq.dev/docs/tutorials/merging-workspaces.md): Confirm a workspace is ready, handle conflicts, and merge completed work into the target branch.
- [Creating Terminal Sessions](https://treq.dev/docs/tutorials/creating-terminal-sessions.md): Open agent and shell terminal sessions inside a workspace.
